# hg platform

**What this page tells you:** every `hg platform` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The environment backup: create, schedule, fetch, restore, verify, prove.

## Synopsis

```text
hg platform backup create [flags]
hg platform install-timer [flags]
hg platform fetch [<backup-id>|latest] [flags]
hg platform restore [flags]
hg platform verify-restore [flags]
hg platform backup prove [flags]
hg platform evidence [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Environment-level backup: fresh routine archives plus the host Nexus overlay, scaffolded into one manifest-ed directory. `restore` replays it onto a re-bootstrapped cluster; `backup prove` emits the design-16 ProofResult (available/restorable).

## `hg platform backup create`

```text
hg platform backup create [flags]
```

Scaffold a full platform backup into a directory.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--to` | `<dir>` | — | Where the backup directory is written. |
| `--sink` | `gs://<bucket>/<prefix>|emulated` | — | Also upload the backup to a sink. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg platform backup create --to ~/platform-backups
hg platform backup prove --from ~/platform-backups/<id>
```

## `hg platform install-timer`

```text
hg platform install-timer [flags]
```

Schedule the backup and a weekly restore verification.

Schedules BOTH the backup and a weekly restore VERIFICATION: without the second, restorable is a state reached once by hand that then drifts while every surface shows the last one.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--to` | `<dir>` | — | Backup destination the timer writes into. |
| `--now` | — | — | Enable and start the timer immediately. |
| `--schedule` | `<oncalendar>` | — | systemd OnCalendar expression for the backup. |
| `--verify-schedule` | `<oncalendar>` | — | systemd OnCalendar expression for the weekly restore verification. |

```text

```

|---|---|---|---|
| `--sink` | `gs://<bucket>/<prefix>|emulated` | — | Sink to read from. |
| `--to` | `<dir>` | — | Where to place the fetched backup. |

## `hg platform restore`

```text

```

|---|---|---|---|
| `--from` | `<backup-dir>` | — | The backup directory to restore from. |

## `hg platform verify-restore`

```text
hg platform verify-restore [flags]
```

Restore into a scratch environment and assert the result.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--from` | `<backup-dir>` | — | Backup directory to verify. |
| `--sink` | `gs://<bucket>/<prefix>|emulated` | — | Verify the newest backup in a sink instead. |

## `hg platform backup prove`

```text
hg platform backup prove [flags]
```

Plat001..007: the fleet is rebuildable, not merely backed up.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--from` | `<backup-dir>` | — | The backup to prove recovery from. |
| `--timeout` | `<seconds>` | `300` | Per-step timeout. |

## `hg platform evidence`

```text
hg platform evidence [flags]
```

Bundle versions, shas, server identity and proofs into one directory.

Evidence bundles versions+SHAs+server identity, the SCRUBBED backup record, and any ProofResult `*.json` the operator saved under `--to`; sweeps for secret shapes before writing. `--sink` uploads it so it survives the machine it describes.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--to` | `<dir>` | — | Where the evidence bundle is written. |
| `--from` | `<backup-dir>` | — | The backup the evidence describes. |
| `--sink` | `gs://<bucket>/<prefix>` | — | Upload the bundle off-machine. |
